shortDescription: Japan's Nippon Life Insurance plans to invest 2 trillion yen ($12.75 billion)in infrastructure financing, including the construction of data centers in the United States, Nikkei Asia reported on Saturday.Reuters could not immediately verify the report.($1 = 156.8600 yen)
